intro.title: About Partdro
intro.subtitle: Your trusted partner for premium drone solutions
intro.p1: Partdro is a specialized drone retailer bridging cutting-edge UAV technology with the needs of consumers and businesses worldwide. From aerial photography enthusiasts to enterprise inspection teams, we provide premium drone solutions backed by expert support.
intro.p2: With deep supply chain connections to leading drone manufacturers, we offer competitive pricing, fast shipping, and local after-sales support. Whether you're a hobbyist, a professional photographer, or an enterprise operations manager, Partdro has the right UAV for your mission.

hero.lead: Tethered facade & window cleaning drone: 20 MPa, 1,000 m²/h, 100 m hose. Cleans curtain walls, solar panels and wind turbines, no scaffolding.
hero.badgeText: A modular aerial cleaning platform built for repeatable high-altitude work.

why.title: 1,000 m²/h high pressure fast cleaning.
why.lead: Artificial cleaning (spiderman, cradles) is still the main cleaning method, facing operational risk, inefficient cleaning, poor operational flexibility and high cost. The D15R cleaning drone features a modular design with two types of cleaning attachments and four nozzles of different angles, providing a convenient, efficient, multi-scenario aerial high-pressure cleaning solution.

0.title: Tethered water supply
0.desc: Long uninterrupted operation without any limitation of water tank capacity.

1.title: 1,000 m²/h max. Quick Wash
1.desc: Fast washing under hovering, D15R can be equipped with dual swinging spray booms optionally for 1,000 m²/h coverage.

2.title: 20 MPa Instantaneous Peak Pressure
2.desc: Fast and effective removal of stubborn stains with high-pressure washing.

3.title: Rapid installation and deployment
3.desc: Folding design for easy transportation and storage; quick release mode for 1-minute deployment.

4.title: 4 different nozzles as standard
4.desc: 0°, 15°, 25° and 40° spray angles — one nozzle pipe, multiple water types, switching of water types from 0-40° at will.

5.title: Adaptable to 2 different loads
5.desc: D15R can be adapted to two types of cleaning attachments: adjustable-angle nozzles and oscillating nozzles.

designed.title: Adaptable to multiple configurations.
designed.lead: The D15R cleaning drone features a modular design, compatible with two types of cleaning attachments: adjustable-angle nozzles and oscillating nozzles. Equipped with four nozzles of different angles, it provides a convenient, efficient, and multi-scenario aerial high-pressure cleaning solution.

0.title: Water nozzle (Fixed)
0.desc: 1500 mm nozzle keeps the fuselage away from the wall, safe and reliable. The nozzle can swing left and right horizontally.

1.title: Oscillating nozzle
1.desc: The swing range of the nozzle is ±15°, and the speed of the swing can be adjusted on the remote control according to the stain level.

2.title: Dual swinging spray boom
2.desc: Optional kit combines foam and water nozzles for one-key remote switching without landing. Completes full foam softening and water rinsing in one flight.

output.note: The product brochure specifies 500 m²/h for deep cleaning. Actual output depends on the work surface, contamination level, cleaning liquid and operating conditions.

spray.title: 4 types of spray nozzles, tool-free installation.
spray.lead: The modular nozzle design meets the needs of customers for diversified cleaning tasks. One nozzle pipe, multiple water types — switching of water types from 0-40° at will.

0.desc: For flushing crevices, stubborn stains, etc.

1.desc: For quick rinsing of stains.

2.desc: Rapid rinsing of sand and soil, higher efficiency.

3.desc: For rinsing large areas after spraying detergent.

intelligence.title: D15R 5.0 — Autonomous operation with route planning.
intelligence.lead: The new upgraded version D15R 5.0 adds intelligent route planning to achieve autonomous operation. It can set routes for different cleaning scenarios, greatly improving the work efficiency and flexibility of the cleaning drone.

0.title: Comprehensive coverage without blind spots
0.desc: The entire facade can be accurately covered according to the set route and height, avoiding omissions and blind spots that may occur during manual inspection or ordinary flight.

1.title: High precision with RTK
1.desc: Combined with advanced positioning technologies such as RTK positioning, the UAV can maintain a stable flight attitude and position accuracy, thereby obtaining high-precision images and measurement data.

2.title: High degree of automation
2.desc: The route can be planned in advance through the ground control station, and the drone can fly automatically according to the preset path without real-time manual control.

3.title: Remote operation
3.desc: The operator can control and monitor the drone from a safe location away from dangerous facades, with timely measures in case of emergency.

safety.title: Dual RTK + wall-following radar for secure flight.
safety.lead: Enabling manual-free high-altitude operations. Replacing manual overhead work with remote-controlled drone operation, built-in dual RTK modules for centimeter-level positioning, and an intelligent perception system with wall-following radar.

0.title: Replacing manual overhead work
0.desc: Remote control of personnel can complete all kinds of complex cleaning tasks at high altitude, eliminating the potential risks of working at height.

1.title: Built-in high-precision dual RTK
1.desc: Equipped with high-precision dual RTK modules, it can output centimeter-level positioning data, ensuring accurate and reliable positioning and safe operation.

2.title: Intelligent Perception System
2.desc: Front-mounted wall-following radar senses real-time distance information ahead, maintains a safe distance, and ensures more secure flight.

multiangle.eyebrow: Multi-scenario — Stable operation at high altitude
multiangle.title: Various nozzles, covering difficult angles.
multiangle.lead: Modular design for different loads, stable operation at high altitude, flexible operation, and multi-angle coverage of bottom and top surfaces.

0.title: Modular design
0.desc: Optimal mounts and nozzles can be customized according to different tasks to meet the configuration needs of various altitude cleaning requirements.

1.title: Stable operation at high altitude
1.desc: Comes with dual RTK and a 'Perception-Decision-Execution' closed-loop system, adapting to various height-based cleaning requirements.

2.title: Flexible operation
2.desc: Flexible traveling, not afraid of narrow building distance and other complex building spaces.

3.title: Multi-angle coverage of bottom and top surfaces
3.desc: Supporting different configurations, it can easily cover the bottom and top surfaces and other complex surfaces.
